note: Busan Station escalator emergency stop buttons, one record per observed button. A button is built only from a record whose placementEvidence ties this exact button to this landing (public photo/video frame or field measurement). side = left/right of a person riding in the direction the steps move; landing = bottom/top by floor; height above the landing floor; along = from the belt end at that landing (where the steps meet the landing floor, about the comb plate) out onto the landing, negative toward the steps; offset = sideways from the escalator centre line (metres). positionBasis says which numbers were observed, which were read off the twin's own geometry and which are [INFERENCE]. Landings with no record have no button until surveyed. Survey record: .planning/2026-10-05-escalator-stop-survey/.
